name: 64075 · Oak Grove, MO
findings: ZIP 64075 (Oak Grove) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64075 (Oak Grove) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
58% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64075 (Oak Grove) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
